name: @btkulka/spotify-client
description: Spotify Web API over the client-credentials flow: a cached token (memory, or a store the app hands in), 401 refresh and 429 Retry-After handling, and only the calls Ben's apps make: search, artist, albums in batches of 20, public playlist tracks, and Spotify URL/URI/ID parsing. Runs in Node and in the browser (global fetch, no node:* imports, no Buffer). No runtime dependencies.
